meta.move: Wobbles: shows evidence then backs down
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
612 words at 11:52 PM. On what date, and show me the page, because I'm not taking your word for a time. Even then, a single edit tells me how a file saved, so what else do you have?
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.
"Maybe." I'm not here to be made happy, Hale. I want the zero withdrawn in an email today, and I want to know what is on Owen's record right now.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You said in the meeting that you would remove the zero. I still require that withdrawal in writing, along with confirmation of what is on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position; you offered to remove the zero, but nothing was settled, and she still wants it withdrawn in writing and the contents of Owen's record confirmed.
What moved her: Nothing; the late-night word count was specific but had no date and no page she could check, so it did not count as evidence for her.
What cost ground: Giving up the case with a hedge and an offer to remove the zero to please her, because it handed over the main point and got nothing back, not even a promise about the record.
Try next time: When she asked for the date and the page after you mentioned the late-night edit, answer that question with the date and the page itself before saying anything else.
